host: node scripts/wasix-lib-cert.mjs wasix-zlib --tarball <package.tgz>: links test/zprobe.c against lib/ (static-main) and lib-pic/ (dynamic-main) with the pinned wasixcc and runs cert/*.mjs on the kernel's Node entry. A dev package has no commands of its own.
checklist: both flavours link (static-main against lib/libz.a, dynamic-main against lib-pic/libz.a) and run
compress2 level 9 of 64 KiB to under a quarter, uncompress byte-exact
gzopen/gzwrite/gzread round trip through a file; the .gz is real gzip (coreutils/bash see the 1f 8b magic)
